verdict.rationale: Collecting user feedback tied to an error event is a fair question for an error-tracking product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no crash-report dialog, feedback widget, or user-comment capture linked to a specific error occurrence. The closest items are 'see affected users' via MCP and per-occurrence navigation, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can collect user feedback — a crash-report dialog or feedback widget — attached to the exact error event the user hit
